description: This Dart file defines the application's routing configuration using the go_router package. It includes route definitions, a navigation state notifier, and a shell widget for bottom navigation

classes.name: RouterNotifier
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that watches authentication status and manages route redirection

classes.name: MainShell
classes.description: A widget that provides a scaffold with a bottom navigation bar and renders the selected screen

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Determines the route to redirect to based on authentication state and current location

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Returns true if the user is authenticated

methods.name: _MainShellState._currentIndexFromLocation
methods.description: Computes the bottom navigation bar index based on current route location

methods.name: _MainShellState._onTap
methods.description: Handles tap events on bottom navigation bar items to change routes

methods.name: _MainShellState.build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree including Scaffold with body and bottom navigation bar
